lines.zh: 我的脚步把地面踩得咚咚响。
lines.en: My steps pound the ground with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 一肩棕菇，一肩红菇，走起来晃。
lines.en: Brown caps on one shoulder, red on the other; I sway.

lines.zh: 我走路要侧着身，太宽了。
lines.en: I have to walk sideways; I am too broad.

lines.zh: 秘境的地砖被我踩裂过。
lines.en: I have cracked the paving stones of Mysterium before.

lines.zh: 这双腿撑得起五十颗心。
lines.en: These legs can carry fifty hearts of weight.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，身上的蘑菇就抖。
lines.en: Each step shakes the mushrooms growing on me.

lines.zh: 让开点，我停不下来。
lines.en: Give me room; I cannot stop short.

lines.zh: 菌柄粗得像柱子，才撑得住我。
lines.en: My stalk is thick as a pillar, or it would not hold me.

lines.zh: 我走在菌毯上，脚陷得很深。
lines.en: On the fungal mat my feet sink deep.

lines.zh: 红菇从背后垂下来，晃来晃去。
lines.en: Red caps hang from my back and swing as I go.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，路会自己让开。
lines.en: I do not detour; the path gives way to me.

lines.zh: 走得越远，身上的菇越沉。
lines.en: The farther I walk, the heavier my mushrooms grow.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的蘑菇也在站。
lines.en: I stand still, and the mushrooms on me stand too.

lines.zh: 五十颗心的体重，压得我脚麻。
lines.en: Fifty hearts of weight leave my feet numb.

lines.zh: 我在数背上有几朵棕菇。
lines.en: I am counting the brown caps on my back.

lines.zh: 神秘菇长得慢，我等得起。
lines.en: Mystery mushrooms grow slowly; I can wait.

lines.zh: 我用指节敲了敲自己的菌盖。
lines.en: I tap my own cap with a knuckle.

lines.zh: 力士也得歇一会儿。
lines.en: Even a strongman needs a moment of rest.

lines.zh: 红菇的味道从背后飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of red caps drifts up from my back.

lines.zh: 我试着不呼吸，菌类不需要。
lines.en: I try not breathing; fungi do not need to.

lines.zh: 这片地被我站出了一个坑。
lines.en: I have stood a hollow into this ground.

lines.zh: 我在想那三朵神秘菇熟没熟。
lines.en: I wonder whether those three mystery caps are ripe.

lines.zh: 安静时，菌丝在土里吵架。
lines.en: In the quiet, the mycelium argues beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 别的生物都离我三步远。
lines.en: Other creatures keep three steps away from me.

lines.zh: 我拍拍肚子，里面全是菌肉。
lines.en: I pat my belly; it is packed with fungus flesh.

lines.zh: 力气不用的时候，会变成饿。
lines.en: Strength left unused turns into hunger.

lines.zh: 我背上的红菇又胖了一圈。
lines.en: The red caps on my back fattened again.

lines.zh: 地砖的缝里也长出了菌。
lines.en: Fungus sprouts from the tile cracks too.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，脚底沾了一层孢子。
lines.en: I lift a foot, spore-coated underneath.

lines.zh: 秘境的风一吹，菌盖发痒。
lines.en: A realm breeze tickles my caps.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你先退了半步。
lines.en: I look down at you, and you step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你太瘦了，我一只手能提起来。
lines.en: You are too thin; I could lift you one-handed.

lines.zh: 你的头顶到我的菌柄中间。
lines.en: Your head reaches only the middle of my stalk.

lines.zh: 我在估你身上有几斤肉。
lines.en: I am estimating how much meat you carry.

lines.zh: 你举着剑，我举着两肩蘑菇。
lines.en: You raise a sword; I raise two shoulders of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，菌盖往前倾。
lines.en: When I look at you, my cap tips forward.

lines.zh: 你不像秘境的东西，太亮了。
lines.en: You do not look like Mysterium; you are too bright.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈和汗味。
lines.en: Iron and old sweat: both are on you.

lines.zh: 别仰头太久，脖子会酸。
lines.en: Do not crane your neck up too long.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛转得快，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your eyes move quickly, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，瘦瘦的那个。
lines.en: I have remembered you, the thin one.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，显得更小。
lines.en: Standing in my shadow, you look even smaller.

lines.zh: 你砍进菌肉，刀被夹住了。
lines.en: You cut into my flesh and the blade sticks.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，你得多砍几下。
lines.en: My hide is thick; you will need more swings.

lines.zh: 疼让我更用力，不是更怕。
lines.en: Pain makes me hit harder, not fear more.

lines.zh: 这一刀削掉了我半朵红菇。
lines.en: That cut shears off half a red cap.

lines.zh: 五十颗心，你砍得完吗。
lines.en: Fifty hearts: can you cut through them all?

lines.zh: 伤口流出的汁是褐色的。
lines.en: The juice leaking from the wound is brown.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，蘑菇却没掉。
lines.en: I stagger, but no mushroom falls.

lines.zh: 你这一下，我会加倍还你。
lines.en: For this blow I will pay you back double.

lines.zh: 我站得稳，因为我本来就重。
lines.en: I stand firm because I was always heavy.

lines.zh: 打疼我的人，通常活不久。
lines.en: Those who hurt me usually do not last long.

lines.zh: 你把面包举起来，我笑了。
lines.en: You hold up bread, and I laugh.

lines.zh: 我背上的蘑菇比那好吃。
lines.en: The mushrooms on my back taste better than that.

lines.zh: 我不吃软的，只吃有嚼劲的。
lines.en: I do not eat soft things, only what resists my teeth.

lines.zh: 那块面包不够我一口。
lines.en: That bread is not even one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 你收起来吧，我用不上。
lines.en: Put it away; it is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 我只对我的蘑菇有胃口。
lines.en: Only my own mushrooms stir my appetite.

lines.zh: 神秘菇的香味，比这浓十倍。
lines.en: A mystery mushroom smells ten times stronger than this.

lines.zh: 你拿食物逗我，像逗小孩。
lines.en: You wave food at me as if I were a child.

lines.zh: 我饿，但不吃别人递的。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I take nothing handed to me.

lines.zh: 再举高点，我要看清你的手。
lines.en: Hold it higher; I want a clear look at your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，被弹出去两步。
lines.en: You run into me and bounce back two steps.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉，撞起来像墙。
lines.en: All this flesh of mine collides like a wall.

lines.zh: 我的蘑菇被撞掉了一朵。
lines.en: One of my mushrooms gets knocked loose.

lines.zh: 你推我，我先站稳再推回去。
lines.en: You push me; I plant my feet and push back.

lines.zh: 两个人挤在一起，谁也没让。
lines.en: Pressed together, neither of us gives an inch.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛是菌柄做的，很硬。
lines.en: My shoulder blades are made of stalk, and hard.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我不觉得疼。
lines.en: Your weight on my foot means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把地上的菇都踩烂了。
lines.en: This collision crushes every mushroom underfoot.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，土被压出坑。
lines.en: I give one step and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，你该走了。
lines.en: After that collision, you should be leaving.

lines.zh: 我们的孢子在空中撞成一团。
lines.en: Our spores collide in the air and knot together.

lines.zh: 力士也有柔软的时候。
lines.en: Even a strongman has his softer hours.

lines.zh: 我把最圆的那朵红菇让给了她。
lines.en: I gave her the roundest red cap I had.

lines.zh: 两副宽肩膀靠在一起，土都动了。
lines.en: Two broad shoulders meet, and the soil shifts.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，蘑菇替我们说。
lines.en: We say nothing; the mushrooms speak for us.

lines.zh: 明年这片菌毯会多出几朵。
lines.en: Next year this mat will carry a few more caps.

lines.zh: 她背上那朵棕菇比我大。
lines.en: The brown cap on her back is bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒在她的影子里。
lines.en: I scatter my spores inside her shadow.

lines.zh: 力气可以分一半给她。
lines.en: I could split my strength and give her half.

lines.zh: 我们肩并肩站着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，也懒得弯。
lines.en: I cannot bend over, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我手上全是菌汁，抓不住东西。
lines.en: My hands are slick with fungus juice.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我一脚踢开。
lines.en: I kick whatever falls to the ground out of my way.

lines.zh: 我要的战利品，自己身上就有。
lines.en: The only loot I want grows on my own body.

lines.zh: 那把剑太轻，捏着没感觉。
lines.en: That sword is too light to feel in my hand.

lines.zh: 我不收集，我只带走蘑菇。
lines.en: I collect nothing; I only carry mushrooms away.

lines.zh: 弯一次腰，蘑菇会全掉。
lines.en: If I bend once, every mushroom falls off.

lines.zh: 你的东西太小，我看不见。
lines.en: Your things are too small for me to notice.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，地上的东西自己烂。
lines.en: I stand still and let what fell rot.

lines.zh: 我的战利品长在背上，不在手里。
lines.en: My spoils grow on my back, not in my hands.

lines.zh: 你踩断一根菌丝，我听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a mycelium thread, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我挑目标先看谁跑得慢。
lines.en: I pick my target by who runs slowest.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道比蘑菇醒神。
lines.en: Your scent is more waking than any mushroom.

lines.zh: 十一点力气，我一次用完。
lines.en: Eleven points of force; I use it all at once.

lines.zh: 我的视线落在你身上，就定了。
lines.en: Once my gaze lands on you, it is settled.

lines.zh: 你离我最近，所以是你。
lines.en: You are nearest to me, so it is you.

lines.zh: 秘境这么大，我偏偏看见你。
lines.en: Mysterium is vast, and yet I saw you.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，追回头的那个。
lines.en: I do not chase the fast; I chase the one who looks back.

lines.zh: 背上的蘑菇一齐转向你。
lines.en: Every mushroom on my back turns toward you.

lines.zh: 你被我选中，应该觉得荣幸。
lines.en: You should feel honored to be chosen.

lines.zh: 我追你的时候，地面在响。
lines.en: When I chase you, the ground makes noise.

lines.zh: 你跑得快，我跑得久。
lines.en: You run faster; I run longer.

lines.zh: 我每踏一步，就离你近一点。
lines.en: Every step I take brings me a little closer.

lines.zh: 别躲树后，我撞得倒那棵树。
lines.en: Do not hide behind a tree; I can knock it down.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我的蘑菇在晃。
lines.en: Look back and see my mushrooms swaying.

lines.zh: 我不喊叫，脚步已经够响了。
lines.en: I do not shout; my footsteps are loud enough.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音在漏位置。
lines.en: Your breathing is leaking your position.

lines.zh: 我一路追，菌毯被我踩平。
lines.en: As I chase, I flatten the fungal mat behind me.

lines.zh: 等我追上，你不会想再跑。
lines.en: When I catch up, you will not want to run again.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背，不眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at your back without blinking.

lines.zh: 我一拳下去，你听见骨头响。
lines.en: My fist lands and you hear a bone crack.

lines.zh: 十一点力气，只用了一半。
lines.en: Eleven points of force, and I used half.

lines.zh: 我抡起手臂，蘑菇跟着飞。
lines.en: I swing my arm and mushrooms fly with it.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌被我砸凹了一块。
lines.en: I hammer a dent into your shield.

lines.zh: 我打人喜欢一次打到底。
lines.en: When I hit, I like to hit all the way through.

lines.zh: 胸口的菌肉震了一下。
lines.en: The fungus flesh on my chest jolts.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我就省力气了。
lines.en: If you back into a wall, I save effort.

lines.zh: 这一击带着五十颗心的重量。
lines.en: This blow carries fifty hearts of weight.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，你已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time I raise my hand, you are too late.

lines.zh: 打中之后，我拍拍手，继续。
lines.en: After the hit I dust my hands and continue.

lines.zh: 我从三朵蘑菇中间长出来。
lines.en: I grow up between three mushrooms.

lines.zh: 落地第一下，我就知道我很重。
lines.en: My first step told me how heavy I am.

lines.zh: 菌盖先鼓起来，然后才是肩。
lines.en: My cap swells first, and then my shoulders.

lines.zh: 秘境多了一个力士，土都在震。
lines.en: Mysterium gains a strongman, and the soil shakes.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着一背的蘑菇。
lines.en: I was born carrying mushrooms on my back.

lines.zh: 第一口气吸得太猛，菌柄响了。
lines.en: My first breath was so deep my stalk creaked.

lines.zh: 我把脚下的土踩实了才站稳。
lines.en: I pack the soil underfoot before I stand firm.

lines.zh: 你听见那声闷响了吗，是我。
lines.en: Did you hear that thud? That was me.

lines.zh: 三个品种的菇，一出生就齐了。
lines.en: Three kinds of mushroom came with me at birth.

lines.zh: 我从菌毯最厚的地方站起来。
lines.en: I rise where the fungal mat is thickest.

lines.zh: 没有谁叫我，我自己来了。
lines.en: Nobody summoned me; I simply arrived.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖顶开泥土，露出一角。
lines.en: My cap pushes the dirt aside and shows a corner.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的菇先焦了。
lines.en: Fire comes and the mushrooms burn first.

lines.zh: 这么重的东西落地，很响。
lines.en: Something this heavy lands with a great noise.

lines.zh: 水太薄，撑不起我的体重。
lines.en: I am too heavy; the water cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我背上的菇掀光了。
lines.en: The blast strips the caps clean off my back.

lines.zh: 箭扎进菌盖，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in my cap and will not pull free.

lines.zh: 药水让我的菌柄发软。
lines.en: The potion makes my stalk go soft.

lines.zh: 我开始吃自己背上的菇。
lines.en: I start eating the mushrooms off my own back.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every part of me goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有重量，我很不习惯。
lines.en: In the void I have no weight, and I hate it.
